title: Dyson V15 £479, Sonos Ace £199 and an AirTag 4-pack for £71.78
description: Thursday's best UK deals: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute £479, Sonos Ace headphones £199, AirTag 4-pack £71.78 and Apple Watch Series 11 £290.
intro:
**Today's standout is the Dyson V15 Detect Absolute at £479 at Currys, £170 under its usual price, with the Sonos Ace headphones down to £199 on Amazon.** It's the eve of Black Friday, so most of the big prices are already live: there's an AirTag 4-pack at under £18 a tag, the Apple Watch Series 11 at £290, a Sony soundbar at £269 and two cordless vacuums for this week's [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight.

Every price below was published on 25 November in TechRadar's and T3's UK Black Friday live coverage, so check the product page before you pay. Buy now or wait? Tomorrow is Black Friday itself (27 November), but Amazon's Black Friday Week prices are already in place and run to Cyber Monday (30 November). We don't expect much lower, and popular colours and sizes are already selling out.

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute cordless vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's laser-lit, dust-counting flagship for £479, a good price for the Absolute kit with both floor heads. Tap the Amazon compare link first, and see our [Dyson V15 deals guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/) for the prices worth paying.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin cordless vacuum
deals.note: The cheaper way into a Dyson: older tech and a shorter run time than the V15, but plenty for a flat or for quick top-ups between big cleans. Not sure which brand? Read [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

deals.name: Suri Core sonic electric toothbrush
deals.note: A slim, rechargeable brush with plant-based heads you can recycle, and it looks good on a shelf. A nice stocking filler for someone who likes neat design; Oral-B fans should see our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Habitat 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree
deals.note: A quarter off Argos's own-brand pre-lit tree, so no untangling lights this year. It's an Argos exclusive, so there's no Amazon equivalent to compare.

deals.name: Sonos Ace wireless noise-cancelling headphones
deals.note: £150 off comfortable over-ears with strong noise cancelling, and they can take the sound from a Sonos soundbar so you can watch late without waking anyone. Long commute? An [Audible trial](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December.

deals.name: Apple AirTag 4-pack (2nd generation)
deals.note: Works out at about £17.90 a tag, so you can split a pack into four small gifts for keys, bags and suitcases. iPhone only; Android users need a different tracker.

deals.name: Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm, GPS)
deals.note: £59 off the larger 46mm size in selected colours; TechRadar says the 42mm has already sold out. Compare models in our [Apple Watch deals guide](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Sony HT-S2000 Dolby Atmos soundbar
deals.note: A single compact bar with virtual Atmos that's a big step up from TV speakers, without a separate sub to find space for. More options in our [soundbar deals guide](/guides/soundbar-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs
deals.note: Soft, reusable silicone plugs for sleeping next to a snorer or blocking out a noisy office, at a record low. An easy add-on to get an order over a free-delivery threshold, or a stocking filler.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not really. The Sonos Ace and Sony soundbar prices are close to the best we've seen, and Amazon's Black Friday Week prices run through to Cyber Monday, so tomorrow's 'official' day is more likely to bring a few flash deals than deeper cuts on these. The one to watch is the Dyson V15: Currys has it at £479, but check the Amazon compare link before you buy, and see our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) for every model's target price. For each retailer's sale dates, see [when is Black Friday 2026 UK](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## This week's spotlight

Our [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers the cordless and robot vacuums at genuine lows and what to pay. Shark fans should also see our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon deal prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of Black Friday Week. For everything else, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) or our [Black Friday live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).
